method: Built-in image_gen, transparent_background: true. Files copied without raster edits.

prompts.round: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: one isolated transparent cloud sprite for a polished pixel-art floating-island website. High-quality hand-painted retro RPG pixel art, crisp stair-stepped silhouette, broad intentional pixel clusters and limited elegant shading. Palette: powder blue, cool pale blue, soft ivory highlights and desaturated medium blue shadows. Rounded volume, peaceful daylight. Solid opaque core, genuine alpha outside, no diffuse glow outside silhouette. Entire cloud fully visible with transparent margins. No sky, no colored backdrop, no checkerboard drawn into image, no buildings, no islands, no people, no text, no border, no photo blur, no purple. One cloud only, no sprite sheet. Primary request: An asymmetric rounded cumulus cloud, compact rather than wide, three uneven pillow-like lobes, one large high puff on the left and a lower broad puff on the right. Squarish composition, tactile volume, clean lower pixel wisps, distinct from a long cloud bank.
